USS Suite

The tactical mission architect for low-voltage security integrators. Design commercial security systems on satellite maps, verify coverage in 3D, and generate complete quotes — all before stepping on site. We built USS because the tools we needed didn't exist.

Satellite-Based Design

Drag-and-drop cameras, access control, and cable paths onto any building.

AI Site Intelligence

Footprint detection, material ID, entry points, and risk assessment.

Automatic Cable Routing

Optimal paths with penetrations, conduit fills, and exact footage.

3D Verification

Orbit the building, check camera FOVs, toggle WiFi heatmaps.

Mobile Site Surveys

01 / Infrastructure

Structured Cabling

Every cabling project starts with a comprehensive site survey and path analysis. We map cable routes, identify IDF/MDF locations, calculate load requirements, and specify materials before pulling a single foot of cable. TIA-568 compliant, Fluke DSX certified, documented on every run.

Cat5e / Cat6 / Cat6A copper
Single & multi-mode fiber (OM3/OM4/OM5)
Patch panels, trays, J-hooks, conduit
Rack-and-stack, cable management & labeling
Fluke DSX certification & documentation
New construction & multi-site rollouts

02 / Video Security

Surveillance Systems

We design surveillance systems around your actual security posture and operational requirements — not a pre-packaged bundle. Camera placement, lens selection, NVR sizing, network bandwidth, and storage retention are all engineered for your specific site, risk profile, and compliance needs. Full lifecycle delivery: site assessment, system design, installation, configuration, user training, and ongoing support.

23 years deploying surveillance across every environment — small businesses, enterprise campuses, retail chains, industrial facilities, healthcare, and government. Every system is NDAA-compliant and built for remote management.

IP cameras 2MP–4K, dome, bullet & turret
PTZ, thermal & license plate recognition (LPR)
AI-powered analytics & alerts
NVRs 8–256+ channels with RAID storage
VMS, remote viewing & cloud platforms
Full surveillance network backbone

03 / Connectivity

Network Engineering

We plan, deploy, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure — from switching and routing to wireless mesh and fiber backbones. Every deployment starts with a network assessment and ends with documented configurations, testing results, and handoff documentation. We handle new builds, renovations, and multi-site rollouts.

STEP 01

Assess

Network assessment, wireless site survey, and heat mapping of your environment.

STEP 02

Engineer

Switching, routing, firewalls, and WiFi designed around your density and budget.

STEP 03

Deploy

Rack-and-stack, cable management, labeling, and clean installation.

STEP 04

Document

Tested configs, performance results, and full handoff documentation.

04 / Entry Systems

Access Control

We design, install, and configure electronic access control systems that let you manage who enters your facility, when, and through which doors. From single-door standalone readers to multi-site cloud-managed platforms with hundreds of doors, we engineer around your operational requirements, compliance needs, and growth plans.

23 years of experience integrating access control with buildings, IT networks, surveillance systems, and security policies. We handle the full picture — door hardware, locking systems, wiring infrastructure, controller programming, credential enrollment, and system integration.

Card readers, fobs & mobile credentials
Biometric & keypad entry
Mag-locks, electric strikes, crash bars
Door position & request-to-exit sensors
Cloud-managed & on-premise platforms
Video integration & visual verification
